### Expected and actual behavior

Identify the stage: rule preparation, import, editing, export or gameplay. For in-game issues, include the campaign date and country. For localization issues, include the displayed text or script key.

### Logs or screenshots

Prefer relevant error excerpts. Remove usernames, personal paths and private data before uploading. A full save is not required for a public report. Localization checks are recorded in `localization_verification.json` when available.

### Known limitations

Resource-building capacity and some vanilla script errors remain known issues. Independent Windows environments and long campaigns are not fully validated. If relevant, add the affected region, building and reproduction conditions.
